name: @six5536/symify-workspace
description: Keep files in sync between a working location and a backing repository, via symlinks or copies.

scripts.build:all: npm run build:linux-x64 && npm run build:linux-arm64 && npm run build:darwin-x64 && npm run build:darwin-arm64
scripts.build:linux-x64: rustup target add x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu && mise exec -- cargo zigbuild --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu -p symify && install -m 0755 target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/symify packages/symify-linux-x64/bin/symify
scripts.build:linux-arm64: rustup target add aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu && mise exec -- cargo zigbuild --release --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu -p symify && install -m 0755 target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/symify packages/symify-linux-arm64/bin/symify
scripts.build:darwin-x64: rustup target add x86_64-apple-darwin && mise exec -- cargo zigbuild --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin -p symify && install -m 0755 target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/symify packages/symify-darwin-x64/bin/symify
scripts.build:darwin-arm64: rustup target add aarch64-apple-darwin && mise exec -- cargo zigbuild --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin -p symify && install -m 0755 target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/symify packages/symify-darwin-arm64/bin/symify
scripts.coverage:check: cargo +nightly llvm-cov clean --workspace && cargo +nightly llvm-cov nextest --workspace --no-report && cargo +nightly llvm-cov report --summary-only --ignore-filename-regex 'generated\.rs|crates/app' --fail-under-lines 90 && cargo +nightly llvm-cov report --summary-only --ignore-filename-regex 'generated\.rs|crates/lib' --fail-under-lines 90
scripts.codegen: cargo typify --no-builder --additional-derive Clone --additional-derive PartialEq --additional-derive Eq schema/symify.schema.json --output crates/lib/symify-core/src/model/generated.rs
